stories.h: ADC fires back at APC over deepfake claims and asks for evidence
stories.p: The ADC has rejected allegations by the ruling party that it is behind deepfake content aimed at President Tinubu. The party challenged the APC to publish proof of its claim. The exchange comes on the day Tinubu launches his re-election campaign in Kaduna.
more: The ADC says accusations alone cannot replace evidence.
The row adds to a growing war of words between both campaigns.

stories.h: MultiChoice reportedly takes final decision on cheaper DStv decoder and subscription prices
stories.p: MultiChoice has reportedly settled on lower prices for DStv decoders and subscriptions in Nigeria. Details of the new price list were said to be shared with customers. Subscribers have been waiting for relief as the cost of living bites.
more: The new prices are said to apply to decoders and some bouquets.
Customers are advised to check official channels for the exact figures.

stories.h: Tonto Dikeh causes a stir by calling out names while delivering a prophecy in church
stories.p: Actress Tonto Dikeh reportedly drew attention online after mentioning specific names while delivering a prophecy during a church service. Clips of the moment have been widely shared, with reactions divided.
more: Some viewers praised her boldness while others questioned the approach.
She has not publicly commented further, according to reports.

stories.h: CAF gives member associations a deadline to choose a 4-year or 2-year AFCON cycle
stories.p: The Confederation of African Football has set a deadline for national associations to decide whether the Africa Cup of Nations should be held every two years or every four years. The outcome will shape the continental calendar for Nigeria and other nations.
more: The decision is expected to affect club-versus-country scheduling.
Associations are expected to vote after the deadline.

stories.h: Remi Tinubu and Tompolo share a cheerful moment at an APC rally
stories.p: First Lady Senator Oluremi Tinubu and Government Ekpemupolo, popularly known as Tompolo, were seen laughing and exchanging warm smiles at an APC rally. Tompolo, a former Niger Delta militant leader, now holds a major federal pipeline security contract and has become an influential figure with ties to the ruling party. The relaxed moment has sparked conversation online about how political relationships evolve in Nigeria.
more: Tompolo wore a cap and vest bearing the name of a pro-Tinubu support group.
His firm's pipeline surveillance contract has been credited by the government with helping to curb oil theft in the Niger Delta.
The rally is part of the APC's 2027 re-election campaign.
stories.alt: Remi Tinubu in green APC attire smiles at Tompolo, seated beside her in a white cap and black vest

stories.h: Fuel marketers reportedly release new diesel prices as Dangote Refinery halts gantry sales
stories.p: Marketers have reportedly published new diesel prices after Dangote Refinery stopped selling diesel at its gantry. The move is said to be tightening supply at depots. Separately, the Edo refinery is reportedly producing above its rated capacity, with daily diesel supply put at about 620,000 litres.
more: Marketers are said to be adjusting pump prices in response.
The Edo refinery figure of 620,000 litres a day has been reported but not independently verified.

stories.h: Qatar sets conditions for foreign newborns to get a free visa on arrival
stories.p: Qatar has announced the conditions under which foreign newborn babies can receive a free visa on arrival at its airports. The announcement is part of wider reporting on the visas available to foreigners landing in the country, including free transit visas for two groups of travellers.
more: Reports differ on whether there are four or five conditions.
Qatar also lists nine visa types available on arrival.

stories.h: Khloe Kardashian says past relationships make her doubt her judgment on men
stories.p: Reality TV star Khloe Kardashian says she has been single for four years. She says her track record in relationships means she does not fully trust herself when it comes to men.
more: She reportedly made the remarks while discussing her love life.

stories.h: Blessing CEO out of detention, Doris Ogala confirms
stories.p: Relationship coach Blessing CEO has been released from detention, actress Doris Ogala has confirmed. Ogala shared a video on social media showing her on a video call with Blessing shortly after her release.
more: Ogala appeared delighted in the clip as she spoke with Blessing.
Blessing CEO has not yet spoken publicly about her release.
stories.alt: Doris Ogala in a cap, sunglasses and striped top smiling during a video call in a car

stories.h: VeryDarkMan calls Davido and his uncle a disappointment over development in Osun
stories.p: VeryDarkMan has described Davido and his uncle, Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke, as a disappointment, criticising what he called poor development in the state. He asked how a family that owns private jets could have so much wealth while Osun still lacks a functioning airport, and how investors are expected to reach the state easily. He urged those in power to use government resources to improve people's lives.
more: VDM also spoke about a past invitation from Davido's brother, B-Red, to meet their father.
Neither Davido nor the Osun State government has responded to the comments.
Fans are split on whether his criticism is fair or too harsh on the Adeleke family.
stories.alt: VeryDarkMan speaking in a selfie video beside a photo of Davido shaking hands with Governor Ademola Adeleke

stories.h: Supporters reportedly carrying sticks and cutlasses arrive for Tinubu's campaign flag-off in Kaduna
stories.p: Some APC supporters were reportedly seen holding sticks and cutlasses as crowds streamed into Ranchers Bees Stadium in Kaduna for the flag-off of President Tinubu's re-election campaign. Many others arrived in party caps and T-shirts, carrying posters of the president. Footage of the arrivals has drawn concern online about safety at campaign events.
more: The Kaduna rally is the first major stop of the APC's 2027 campaign tour.
The party has not commented on the reports of supporters carrying weapons.
Port Harcourt is reportedly the next stop on the campaign trail.
stories.alt: Crowds in party caps and T-shirts, some holding APC posters, arrive at a stadium in Kaduna

stories.h: Man sees his new face for the first time, 24 hours after his own child gave him a facelift
stories.p: A viral video shows a father looking at his new face for the first time, just a day after a facelift performed by his own child. Before and after images show his face still swollen and taped, with surgical dressings still in place shortly after the operation. Viewers have been amazed that he barely recognised himself.
more: Swelling is normal so soon after surgery, so the final result could look quite different once he heals.
The healing process for a facelift usually takes weeks to settle.
Many viewers praised the child for trusting their skills on their own parent.
stories.alt: Before surgery, bandaged after the operation, and 24 hours after: an older man's face during facelift recovery

stories.h: Businesswoman Jaruma reportedly detained by police over social media posts about Seyi Tinubu
stories.p: Businesswoman Jaruma is reportedly in police custody following posts she made online about a woman said to be linked to Seyi Tinubu. The reasons for her detention have not been officially explained. The police are yet to issue a public statement.
more: Reports say the detention followed her online posts.
No official statement from the police at the time of writing.

stories.h: Dutch-born Serie A player reportedly agrees to play for the Super Eagles
stories.p: A Dutch-born player in Italy's Serie A has reportedly agreed to represent Nigeria at senior level. The move would be a boost for the national team. The Nigeria Football Federation has not yet confirmed the switch.
more: The player is said to qualify through Nigerian heritage.
Official confirmation is still awaited.

stories.h: Adekunle Gold announces $20,000 initiative for sickle cell patients in four countries
stories.p: Singer Adekunle Gold has launched a $20,000 programme to support people living with sickle cell across four countries. The announcement drew praise from fans online.
more: The programme covers patients in four countries.
Fans have praised the gesture on social media.
stories.alt: Adekunle Gold singing into a microphone

stories.h: King CND criticises Burna Boy over reconciliation with Davido, citing VeryDarkMan
stories.p: Content creator King CND has reportedly accused Burna Boy of betraying VeryDarkMan after the singer made peace with Davido. His remarks have drawn mixed reactions from fans online.
more: King CND says the reconciliation undermined VeryDarkMan.
Fans of both singers have reacted online.
stories.alt: Burna Boy performing on stage
stories.credit: Photo: Nuță Lucian from Cluj-Napoca, Romania / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0)

stories.h: DJ DSF says people who cannot afford children should not have them
stories.p: DJ DSF has sparked debate online after saying people who cannot afford to raise children should not have them. Reactions have been split between those who agree and those who call the comments insensitive.
more: The comments have started a debate on parenting and finances.
Social media users are divided.

stories.h: Federal government places 15 states on Ebola alert and orders isolation centres
stories.p: The federal government has reportedly put 15 states on alert over Ebola and told hospitals to prepare isolation centres. The move follows the confirmed case in Abuja and growing concern about the virus returning to Nigeria.
more: Health officials are said to be urging states to step up surveillance at points of entry.
Public explainers are tracing how a disease first identified in 1976 has returned.
stories.alt: Electron micrograph of Ebola virus particles

stories.h: APC accuses Atiku and ADC of a fake news plot against Tinubu's Kaduna rally
stories.p: The ruling party has reportedly accused Atiku Abubakar and the ADC of spreading false reports to sabotage its campaign flag-off in Kaduna. There was no immediate response from the ADC camp in the reports seen. The ADC has reportedly fired back, rejecting the deepfake claims and challenging the APC to provide evidence.
more: The rally is the first big stop of the APC re-election campaign.
The ADC has been busy with its own campaign council inauguration in Abuja this weekend.
stories.alt: Lugard Hall, the old parliament building in Kaduna
stories.credit: Photo: Dr Mary Gillham Archive Project / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0)

stories.h: Soludo says backing Tinubu in 2027 could pave the way for an Igbo presidency
stories.p: Anambra governor Charles Soludo has reportedly argued that supporting the president's second-term bid could open the door to an Igbo presidency later. His remarks come as the debate over Igbo political terms continues between Peter Obi and David Umahi.
more: Umahi earlier asked why Igbos should do only four years when others did eight.
Obi's camp has not been reported as responding to Soludo yet.
stories.alt: Anambra governor Charles Soludo in a red cap

stories.h: Antonio Conte reportedly in talks over Manchester United job and sets conditions
stories.p: Former Chelsea manager Antonio Conte has reportedly discussed replacing Michael Carrick at Manchester United and laid out the terms he would want. Nothing has been confirmed by the club.
more: Carrick is said to be weighing action against Bruno Fernandes over his recent comments.
United are in Champions League action this week.
stories.alt: Antonio Conte at a press conference
stories.credit: Photo: Clément Bucco-Lechat / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0)

stories.h: Viral video of Wizkid's father in the trenches splits fans
stories.p: A viral clip said to show Wizkid's father in the trenches has sparked a fierce argument between fans online. An old post by the singer about his father has resurfaced in the row.
more: Fans on both sides have been trading posts on X and Instagram.
Wizkid has not been reported to have commented on the clip.
stories.alt: Wizkid performing on stage
stories.credit: Photo: TCD PHOTOGRAPHY/The TCD Concept Ltd / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0)

stories.h: Empress Njamah shares plans Francis Duru's wife had for him before his death
stories.p: Actress Empress Njamah has reportedly revealed what the late Francis Duru's wife had planned for him before his sudden death. An old prophecy about his passing has also resurfaced, drawing reactions from Nollywood colleagues.
more: A family source has shared details about his final hours.
Tributes continue to pour in from across Nollywood.

stories.h: Turkish pundit questions Osimhen's man of the match award after Galatasaray beat Lille
stories.p: A Turkish commentator has reportedly doubted whether Victor Osimhen deserved the Champions League man of the match award in Galatasaray's win over Lille.
more: Galatasaray took the three points in the Champions League tie.
Osimhen's form remains a major talking point among Nigerian fans.
stories.alt: Victor Osimhen in a Nigeria jersey
stories.credit: Photo: Fédération Guinéenne Football / Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

stories.h: Lewandowski names his pick for the 2026 Ballon d'Or
stories.p: Robert Lewandowski has reportedly said who he thinks should win this year's Ballon d'Or, choosing from Harry Kane, Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe. The ceremony takes place in London in a few days.
more: Updated rankings were published ahead of the ceremony.
Messi has just won the Princess of Asturias Award.
stories.alt: Robert Lewandowski
stories.credit: Photo: Bryan Berlin / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

stories.h: Gombe Assembly approves state police amendment
stories.p: The Gombe State House of Assembly has reportedly backed the proposed constitutional amendments that would allow state police, adding to the states already on board.
more: The count of states approving has been climbing towards the required 24.
Supporters say it will improve local security response.
stories.alt: Armed officers of the Nigeria Police Force
stories.credit: Photo: AMISOM Public Information / Wikimedia Commons (CC0)

stories.h: Atiku inaugurates ADC presidential campaign council as Tinubu heads to Kaduna
stories.p: Atiku Abubakar has reportedly inaugurated the ADC presidential campaign council in Abuja, on the same weekend the APC begins its re-election campaign in Kaduna. APC campaign chief Abdulaziz Yari has played down the threat from both Atiku and Peter Obi.
more: Yari says Port Harcourt and Maiduguri are the next stops on Tinubu's campaign trail.
The ADC council has reportedly criticised Kwankwaso for urging Atiku to step aside for Obi.
stories.alt: Atiku Abubakar in a blue cap and striped kaftan speaks into a microphone at an event

stories.h: Dangote and depot owners reportedly set for new petrol price rise after crude increase
stories.p: Petrol prices are said to be heading up again as crude oil rises, according to reports. The move comes just a day after depots were reported to have cut petrol and diesel rates nationwide.
more: The NLC has given government until 27 October to act on fuel prices and minimum wage.
Marketers are said to be watching crude movements before confirming new pump prices.
stories.alt: Aliko Dangote in a dark suit
stories.credit: Photo: Saba Dubai / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 3.0)

stories.h: FBI reportedly publishes names and photos of four Nigerians wanted over $6m email fraud
stories.p: The FBI has reportedly released the names and photos of four Nigerians it wants in connection with a $6 million business email compromise scheme.
more: Separately, a Nigerian man has reportedly been declared wanted in the US over alleged $3.1m Medicare fraud.
stories.alt: FBI headquarters, the J. Edgar Hoover Building, in Washington
stories.credit: Photo: Ryan J. Reilly / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0)

stories.h: Remi Tinubu says when she wants to leave Aso Rock
stories.p: The First Lady has reportedly spoken about when she hopes to leave the presidential villa, as her husband begins his 2027 re-election campaign.
more: The remarks come on the day of the APC campaign flag-off in Kaduna.
stories.alt: Remi Tinubu in a gold headtie

stories.h: Jarvis explains why she keeps her family away from husband Peller
stories.p: Jarvis has reportedly explained why she does not let her relatives talk to her husband Peller, following their latest clash over her younger sister's streaming career.
more: The couple reportedly argued live before Peller took her off the stream.
Peller earlier said he needs to grow into a man after the fight.
stories.alt: Streamer Peller

stories.h: Itele reportedly explains why he cautioned his wife and defended Irewole Olaniyan
stories.p: Actor Itele has reportedly spoken about his stance in an ongoing affair controversy, saying why he warned his wife and backed Irewole Olaniyan.
more: Online reaction to his comments is said to be mixed.

stories.h: Melania Trump reportedly helps secure temporary Russia-Ukraine ceasefire for Oleshky evacuation
stories.p: A temporary ceasefire has reportedly been agreed to let elderly residents leave the town of Oleshky, with Melania Trump said to have played a part.
more: The pause is said to be limited to the evacuation of older residents.
stories.alt: Melania Trump in front of a US flag
stories.credit: Photo: The White House / Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

stories.h: Runaway truck reportedly kills 11 after ramming vehicles in Gombe
stories.p: A runaway truck reportedly crashed into several vehicles in Gombe, leaving 11 people dead. Details on the number of injured and the cause of the brake failure were still emerging.
more: Emergency workers are said to have been at the scene.
Authorities have yet to give a full account of the crash.

stories.h: Another building collapse in Lagos leaves people dead and injured, reports say
stories.p: A building has reportedly collapsed in Lagos, with deaths and injuries reported. Rescue teams were said to be at the site, and the cause is yet to be established.
more: It is the latest in a string of collapses reported in recent days.
Officials are expected to investigate the structure.
stories.alt: Lagos city skyline across the lagoon

stories.h: CBN reportedly grants JPMorgan approval to open a banking service in Nigeria
stories.p: The Central Bank of Nigeria has reportedly approved US firm JPMorgan to set up a merchant banking operation in the country, in what would be a notable boost for foreign participation in the sector.
more: The approval was reported by several Nigerian outlets.
Further details on the licence are awaited.
stories.alt: Central Bank of Nigeria headquarters in Abuja

stories.h: Messi wins Princess of Asturias Award days before the Ballon d'Or ceremony
stories.p: Lionel Messi has reportedly won the Princess of Asturias Award, and Barcelona has congratulated him. The honour comes just days before the Ballon d'Or ceremony in London.
more: Barcelona publicly reacted to the news.
The Ballon d'Or ceremony takes place in London this week.
stories.alt: Lionel Messi in an Argentina shirt
stories.credit: Photo: Bryan Berlin / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

stories.h: Trabzonspor gives update on Andre Onana after car accident in Turkey
stories.p: Trabzonspor has reportedly issued an update on goalkeeper Andre Onana, who is on loan from Manchester United, after he was involved in a car accident in Turkey.
more: The club said to be monitoring his condition.
No further details were immediately released.
stories.alt: Andre Onana in a Cameroon training top

stories.h: Bruno Fernandes' home reportedly burgled during Manchester United's Champions League defeat
stories.p: Burglars reportedly broke into the home of Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes while the team was losing to Como in the Champions League.
more: The break-in was reported by several football outlets.
Police inquiries are said to be under way.
stories.alt: Bruno Fernandes in a Portugal jacket
stories.credit: Photo: Bryan Berlin / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

stories.h: Luxury SUVs for Tinubu's 2027 campaign spark anger as UN says 17.9m more Nigerians are now poor
stories.p: Photos of brand-new SUVs branded "#TinubuAgain 2027" are going round online, and many Nigerians are not happy. Posts on social media say the campaign is using BMW, Range Rover, GMC and Acura vehicles. We could confirm that GMC and Toyota SUVs have been given out, but not the other brands.
more: This week, Defence Minister Bello Matawalle gave GMC Terrain SUVs to eight Zamfara lawmakers who stayed in the APC. Kaduna Governor Uba Sani gave Toyota Highlanders to APC council chairmen, and Tompolo's support group has sent dozens of vehicles to Kogi, Kwara and other states.
APC supporters say the cars were bought by party members and support groups, not with government money, and there is no evidence so far that public funds were used.

It comes days after a UN report said 17.9 million more Nigerians fell into poverty between 2021 and 2024, the biggest rise of any country in the world. That period covers Buhari's last two years and Tinubu's first year.
Many people online are asking why the money is not being spent on ambulances and hospital equipment instead.
alts: SUVs parked in a row carrying #TinubuAgain 2027 campaign branding, beside a photo of President Tinubu
A campaign-wrapped SUV door showing Tinubu and APC 2027 branding, beside a photo of President Tinubu
stories.credit: Photo: Nosa Asemota / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)
stories.alt: President Bola Tinubu in a cap and agbada

stories.h: FG reportedly secures 653 convictions in latest Abuja mass terrorism trial
stories.p: The Federal Government has reportedly secured convictions of 653 people in a mass terrorism trial in Abuja. The figure is said to come from the latest phase of a series of trials that began earlier this year, and it has not yet been independently confirmed.
more: Earlier phases of the trials reported hundreds of convictions, with sentences said to range from several years to life.
The Attorney General has led the prosecutions.
stories.alt: Office buildings in Abuja

stories.h: List of Nigerian politicians' children linked to financial crime cases goes round
stories.p: A compiled list of children of prominent Nigerian politicians facing financial crime allegations is drawing attention online. It includes the 16-count money laundering case against former Attorney-General Abubakar Malami, his wife and son, who have pleaded not guilty to charges involving about ₦8.7bn.
more: The Malami case is before a Federal High Court in Abuja.
The defendants deny all the charges.
stories.alt: The National Assembly complex in Abuja
stories.credit: Photo: Shiraz Chakera / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0)

stories.h: Mexico reportedly clears Reno Omokri as Nigeria's envoy to four countries
stories.p: Mexico has reportedly approved Reno Omokri to serve as Nigeria's ambassador covering four countries in Latin America. The clearance is said to remove the last hurdle before he takes up the post.
more: The approval was reported by a Nigerian news site.
No date has been given for his formal posting.
stories.alt: Reno Omokri holding a framed certificate

stories.h: Officer Woos hits back at critic over silence while Broda Shaggi was away
stories.p: Skit maker Officer Woos, an associate of comedian Broda Shaggi, has reportedly replied to a critic who questioned why he stayed quiet while his colleague was away. He is said to have defended his conduct in a public response.
more: The exchange has drawn mixed reactions online.
Neither side has said more.
stories.alt: Comedian Broda Shaggi

stories.h: Bauchi NDC governorship candidate Ibrahim Kashim quits the party
stories.p: Ibrahim Kashim, the NDC governorship candidate in Bauchi State and a former state secretary, has resigned from the party citing personal reasons. The NDC says it will hold fresh congresses to fill the vacancy and has accused the APC of luring its candidates away. A report says other NDC candidates in the state could follow him out.
more: The NDC says it will use provisions of the Electoral Act, 2026 to replace affected candidates.
Kashim has not said which party he may join next, though speculation links him to the APC.
A similar dispute is ongoing over the NDC governorship ticket in Kaduna State.

stories.h: KC Luxury reportedly arrives at Lagos court in an ambulance as lawyer seeks medical bail
stories.p: Socialite KC Luxury was reportedly brought to a Lagos court in an ambulance, with his lawyer asking for bail on medical grounds. He is facing a multi-count drug-related case brought by the anti-narcotics agency and has denied the charges.
more: He earlier pleaded not guilty to all counts alongside two co-defendants.
His lawyers have also challenged his detention in a separate suit.

stories.h: Updated Ballon d'Or rankings published days before London ceremony
stories.p: Fresh rankings for the 2026 Ballon d'Or have reportedly been released just days ahead of the award ceremony in London. Football fans in Nigeria and beyond are debating who deserves the trophy.
more: The ceremony is due to take place in London early next week.
Several players are said to be in contention for the top prize.
stories.alt: A Ballon d'Or trophy on display

stories.h: Ooni's Queen Naomi opens up on four-year university journey ahead of convocation
stories.p: Queen Naomi has reportedly spoken about her four years at university, including retaking JAMB and balancing motherhood with her studies. She is said to be preparing for her 2026 convocation.
more: She says she sat the JAMB exam a second time before gaining admission.

stories.h: Isaac Fayose shares photos with Wike's son Joaquin, calls him his younger brother
stories.p: Isaac Fayose, son of former Ekiti governor Ayodele Fayose, has posted photos of himself spending time with Joaquin, the son of FCT Minister Nyesom Wike. He described the young man as his younger brother. The pictures drew lively reactions online.
more: The two fathers are among the best-known figures in Nigerian politics.
Reactions online have mostly been light-hearted.
stories.alt: Nyesom Wike

stories.h: Arsenal's Bukayo Saka reportedly facing six to eight weeks out with a thigh injury
stories.p: Arsenal winger Bukayo Saka is reportedly set to miss between six and eight weeks with a thigh problem. The England international is said to be a major doubt for upcoming club and national fixtures.
more: The club has not yet published a full medical update.
The injury is a setback for Arsenal's busy fixture schedule.
stories.alt: Bukayo Saka in an England shirt
stories.credit: Photo: Bryan Berlin / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

stories.h: APC youth leader and wife reportedly kidnapped by gunmen at their home
stories.p: A youth leader of the APC and his wife were reportedly abducted by gunmen at their home. The incident comes days after an APC lawmaker was reportedly kidnapped and later killed.
more: Police are yet to give details of the abduction.
Insecurity is again a talking point as campaigns for 2027 get under way.

stories.h: Tinubu's 2027 re-election campaign flags off in Kaduna today
stories.p: The APC is launching President Tinubu's second-term campaign in Kaduna on Saturday, the first stop on a tour of selected states. Port Harcourt is reportedly next on 7 November, with a closing rally planned for Lagos in January. Rival camps, including Atiku's ADC and the Obi-Kwankwaso NDC, have also been mobilising their own campaign councils.
more: Campaign DG Abdulaziz Yari says Tinubu has a broader national base than his challengers.
The presidential election is reportedly set for 16 January 2027.
Supporters of other APC figures have also been reacting to the flag-off.
stories.alt: President Bola Tinubu in a cream agbada and cap speaks at a green lectern, flanked by aides and a soldier

stories.h: Peller and Jarvis reportedly clash again, this time over her younger sister
stories.p: A fresh argument between the streamers has reportedly spilled online, with the couple disagreeing over her younger sister and where family boundaries should lie. It follows their live-stream fight and the decision to block each other earlier this week.
more: Peller recently said he needs to grow into a man after the first clash.
The pair are two months into their marriage.
stories.alt: Streamer Peller

stories.h: Agbese rejects Kingibe's claim of a 25% fuel levy as false
stories.p: Agbese has reportedly hit back at Kingibe, calling his allegation of a 25% levy on fuel a fabrication. The exchange adds to the growing war of words ahead of the 2027 polls.
more: No official figures on the alleged levy have been published.
Both sides are expected to keep trading claims as campaigns heat up.

stories.h: Kogi APC group warns Faleke-Audu loyalists over alleged anti-party moves
stories.p: A group within the Kogi APC has reportedly cautioned loyalists of Faleke and Audu over alleged anti-party activity ahead of 2027. The loyalists have not yet publicly responded.
more: Internal party tensions are surfacing in several states as primaries and campaigns advance.
The party has not announced any disciplinary action.

stories.h: Two former senior FBI officials charged over testimony about Hunter Biden laptop
stories.p: Two former senior FBI officials have reportedly been charged with misleading Congress over matters linked to the Hunter Biden laptop story. The charges are allegations and neither man has been convicted.
more: The case is expected to draw sharp political reaction in Washington.
Court dates have not yet been widely reported.
stories.alt: FBI headquarters, the J. Edgar Hoover Building, in Washington
stories.credit: Photo: Ryan J. Reilly / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0)

stories.h: Atiku camp calls Tinubu's 90-day cost-of-living plan "election bait"
stories.p: Atiku's campaign has reportedly dismissed the president's 90-day plan to ease the cost of living as a pre-election move. The plan was backed by the National Economic Council a day earlier, though details have not been published. The presidency has not yet responded to the claim.
more: The National Economic Council endorsed the plan on Thursday.
Full details of the measures are yet to be released.
Tinubu's 2027 campaign has just been flagged off.
stories.alt: Atiku Abubakar in a suit

stories.h: Wike reportedly denies endorsing Labour Party's Abbo in Adamawa governorship race
stories.p: Claims that FCT Minister Nyesom Wike backed the Labour Party's candidate for the Adamawa governorship have drawn attention online. Wike is said to have denied the report. Observers are watching how the race develops ahead of 2027.
more: Wike has reportedly rejected the endorsement claim.
The Adamawa governorship race is attracting wider attention.
stories.alt: Nyesom Wike

stories.h: King CND reportedly slams Burna Boy over reconciliation with Davido
stories.p: Content creator King CND has reportedly criticised Burna Boy for making peace with Davido, saying he betrayed VeryDarkMan. The comments come as the feud between VeryDarkMan and Davido continues to trend.
more: VeryDarkMan recently showed a school renovation said to be funded by Burna Boy.
The Davido and VeryDarkMan feud is still generating reactions online.
stories.alt: Burna Boy performing on stage
stories.credit: Photo: Nuță Lucian from Cluj-Napoca, Romania / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0)

stories.h: Peller says he needs to grow into a man after clash with Jarvis
stories.p: Streamer Peller has reportedly spoken out following a heated exchange with his pregnant wife Jarvis, which was said to involve a disagreement over her younger sister and family boundaries. He admitted he has some growing up to do. The couple's fallout has drawn heavy reaction online.
more: Earlier in the week the pair were said to have blocked each other after a live-stream row.
Fans are split between backing Peller and defending Jarvis.
stories.alt: Streamer Peller

stories.h: Kwankwaso reportedly says Tinubu does not deserve a second term
stories.p: Former Kano governor Rabiu Kwankwaso has reportedly said President Tinubu does not deserve a second term in office. The remark comes as the 2027 campaign season gathers pace, with the ruling party's camp yet to respond.
more: Kwankwaso is on the NDC ticket with Peter Obi.
Tinubu's camp opened its campaign with a flag-off in Kaduna.
stories.alt: Rabiu Kwankwaso speaking to the press

stories.h: Adekunle Gold announces $20,000 initiative for sickle cell patients
stories.p: Singer Adekunle Gold has announced a $20,000 initiative to support people living with sickle cell across four countries. He reportedly shared details of the programme on social media, and fans have praised the move.
more: The programme is said to cover patients in four countries.
Details on how to apply have yet to be widely shared.
stories.alt: Adekunle Gold singing into a microphone

stories.h: Lagos police commissioner orders detention of officers seen harassing a young man in Ikorodu
stories.p: The Lagos police commissioner has reportedly ordered the detention of officers captured on video harassing a young man in Ikorodu. The footage spread online and drew public anger, and an internal investigation is said to be under way.
more: The video went viral on social media this week.
Rights groups have called for the officers to face disciplinary action.
stories.alt: Armed officers of the Nigeria Police Force
stories.credit: Photo: AMISOM Public Information / Wikimedia Commons (CC0)

stories.h: Ronaldo scores his 982nd career goal
stories.p: Cristiano Ronaldo has reportedly added to his record tally with his 982nd career goal. The Portuguese forward continues to extend his lead as the most prolific scorer in the history of the game.
more: He is closing in on a historic 1,000 career goals.
Fans online celebrated the milestone.
stories.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo in a Portugal shirt
stories.credit: Photo: Bryan Berlin / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

stories.h: NLC gives government until 27 October on fuel price and minimum wage
stories.p: The Nigeria Labour Congress has reportedly handed the federal government a four-day deadline to cut fuel prices and review the minimum wage. The union is said to be warning of possible action if nothing is done by 27 October.
more: Depots have lately lowered petrol and diesel rates.
Government has not yet replied to the ultimatum.
stories.alt: Nigeria Labour Congress members on a protest march

stories.h: Atiku criticises reports of security agents guarding Tinubu's campaign banners in Kaduna
stories.p: Atiku Abubakar has reportedly taken aim at President Tinubu over claims that security personnel were deployed to protect campaign materials in Kaduna ahead of the APC flag-off. The APC has pledged a strong turnout for Saturday's launch.
more: Atiku's camp has also called the 90-day cost-of-living plan 'election bait'.
The Tinubu camp has not commented on the banner claim.
stories.alt: Atiku Abubakar in a suit

stories.h: Umahi says the Lagos-Calabar highway could stall if Tinubu loses in 2027
stories.p: Works Minister David Umahi has reportedly urged voters to back Tinubu, saying the Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway may stay unfinished otherwise. He also said Peter Obi is no threat to the president.
more: The remarks drew mixed reactions online.
Opposition parties are yet to respond.
stories.alt: Dave Umahi in a red cap

stories.h: One reportedly killed as thugs attack a candidate's convoy linked to Kwankwaso's party
stories.p: Reports say hoodlums attacked the convoy of a candidate from the party of Rabiu Kwankwaso, leaving one person dead. Details of the location and any arrests have not been confirmed.
more: Parties have been urged to keep campaigns peaceful.
Police are yet to issue a statement.
stories.alt: Rabiu Kwankwaso speaking to the press

stories.h: Obasanjo's son names his preferred 2027 presidential candidate
stories.p: Olujuwon Obasanjo, son of former President Olusegun Obasanjo, has declared whom he prefers among Tinubu, Obi and Makinde for 2027. The comment adds to the debate over a southern candidate.
more: His father has been openly critical of the Tinubu government.
Supporters of each camp have reacted online.
stories.alt: Olusegun Obasanjo
stories.credit: Photo: Helene C. Stikkel / Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

stories.h: Zlatan reportedly buys Hermes bag for his bride ahead of weekend wedding
stories.p: Singer Zlatan is said to have bought an expensive Hermes handbag for his fiancée before their wedding this Saturday. He also joked with fans on the street about contributing to the wedding costs.
more: Israel DMW earlier revealed what the aso ebi cost.
Guests are expected from across the entertainment scene.
